summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 bug fixes on Next.js public site (localhost:3001) for /portfolio and /. All three bug fixes verified as working. Grid renders uniform 267px cards with 19-20px row gaps, only one marquee-divider on /portfolio, hero kicker text is 'PORTFOLIO', 15 diagonal ribbons present with 0 forbidden 'STOCK FOOTAGE / Stock · not client' text lines inside cards on both /portfolio and /. Filter interactivity verified for Weddings (3), Corporate Events (3), All work (15) — all keep uniform 267px heights.
critical_code_review_comments: lib/portfolio.js still carries unused span:'wide'|'tall' fields — main agent noted this is intentional. Suggest removing dead fields in a future cleanup to avoid confusion, but not a bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portfolio page filters use data-testid pattern 'portfolio-filter-{key}' (all, weddings, birthdays, naming, corporate, lifestyle). Cards use 'portfolio-card-*', ribbons 'portfolio-ribbon-*', marquee 'marquee-divider'. Cookie banner testid: 'cookie-consent-necessary-only'. Public Next.js site at localhost:3001 is separate from FastAPI backend (8001) and CRA portal (3000).
